title: chrysanthemum balsamitoides
intro: Chrysanthemum balsamitoides, commonly known as Balsam Chattan, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family, Asteraceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Chrysanthemum balsamitoides include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory properties, which contribute to its ability to lower blood pressure and improve overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
